admin_controls.value: None. The contract is immutable with no owner, admin keys, pause mechanisms, upgradeability, proxy patterns, or blacklists.

backing.value: Backed 1:1 by native Ether (ETH) held in the contract. Total supply is defined by address(this).balance, ensuring every 1 WETH is backed by exactly 1 ETH locked in the smart contract bytecode.

issuer.value: WETH has no central issuer, administrator, or legal corporate entity. It was deployed in 2017 by the Ethereum/DappHub developer community as an autonomous, unowned, and immutable smart contract.

liquidity.value: Extremely deep liquidity; over 2 million ETH locked (multi-billion dollar TVL) in the WETH9 contract. WETH serves as the core base pairing asset across Ethereum DEXs (e.g. Uniswap V3) and lending protocols.

price_oracle.value: None. The WETH9 contract operates purely through deterministic 1:1 internal accounting without any external price feeds or oracles.

redemption.value: Instant, programmatic, permissionless 1:1 redemption through the withdraw() function in the WETH9 contract. Burning WETH sends an equal amount of native ETH to the caller without fees or timelocks.

regulatory.value: WETH is an autonomous software utility wrapper deployed without a corporate issuer. Native ETH is widely treated as a non-security commodity, with SEC-approved spot ETH ETFs trading in the United States.

underlying.value: Native Ether (ETH), the base currency and native gas asset of the Ethereum blockchain.

structured_output.tier_rationale: WETH is backed 1:1 by native Ether locked in an immutable smart contract deployed in December 2017 with no owner or administrative control. Users can permissionlessly deposit ETH to mint WETH or call withdraw to redeem native ETH 1:1 on-demand at any time. The contract has operated continuously for nearly nine years without exploits or depegs, maintaining multi-billion dollar liquidity across Ethereum DeFi.
